data.long_meaning: Eshwari is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Goddess of Wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Eshwari is the wife of Lord Ganesha and is also known as the Goddess of Fortune. She is worshipped for prosperity, success, and abundance.

This name is often associated with the Goddess of Fortune and is believed to bring good fortune and success. In weddings and other auspicious occasions, Eshwari is invoked for good luck and prosperity.

She is believed to bestow blessings of material wealth and spiritual enrichment. Eshwari is also a symbol of abundance and the multiplicity of the Divine. Worshipping Eshwari is believed to help individuals overcome the attachment to material wealth and promote contentment and inner peace.
